attempted_claim: Let k, C be as in the genus-2 setting, M_GL the derived rank-3 GL(3)-Higgs stack with its canonical 0-shifted symplectic/Poisson data, det-tr: M_GL -> Pic(C) \times H^0(C,K_C) the determinant-of-bundle plus trace-of-Higgs-field morphism, M_SL the derived fixed-determinant traceless SL(3)-Higgs fiber over a fixed (L_0,0) with r=3, and q: M_SL -> M_PGL the rigidification quotient by the residual B G_m-gerbe of scalar automorphisms. Prove or disprove that the canonical 0-shifted Poisson structure on M_GL restricts to a canonical 0-shifted symplectic structure on M_SL, descends to M_PGL up to an identified G_m-weight, and that the shift-classification on M_SL differs from M_GL in that a named shift present on M_GL vanishes on M_SL (state which shift). Scope is fixed g=2, r=3, fixed determinant line bundle of coprime degree and zero trace. A complete answer is a proof of the restriction/descent/non-descent statements with the polyvector/fiber-sequence computation, or an explicit obstruction class or exotic shifted Poisson structure on M_SL or M_PGL contradicting the stated restriction/descent/vanishing claim.
decisive_failure: originality: Headline is substantively covered by prior general theorems, not new: PTVV Cor 2.6 gives canonical 0-shifted symplectic on RLocDol(C,G)=Map(C_Dol,BG) for every reductive G including SL3/PGL3, and PTVV Sec 3 proves fixed-determinant fibers stay symplectic; Park-You proves general d<=0 BGm Hamiltonian rigidification. The g=2,r=3 trace-center splitting and 2-shifted-center vanishing are mechanical instances. A failed literal search or timestamp does not establish priority. value: Fixed g=2,r=3 specialization is an arbitrary finite slice and mere parameter substitution of the general (g,r,char not dividing r) statement the draft itself notes; it restates textbook PTVV-plus-Hitchin leaf material with linear-algebra certification. No new boundary, invariant, obstruction, or downstream use is established beyond what the general theorem already supplies for retrieval.
